description: Application security, Zero Trust, Post-Quantum Cryptography, Red Teaming, and DFIR.

appsec_devsecops.description: SAST, DAST, IAST, SBOM supply chain auditing, and automated container scanning.

zero_trust_network.name: Zero Trust Architecture & Cloud Security
zero_trust_network.description: Micro-segmentation, identity-aware proxies, CSPM, and eBPF runtime observability.

cryptography_pqc.description: NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA), homomorphic encryption, and hardware enclaves.

red_team_offensive.name: Offensive Security & Red Teaming
red_team_offensive.description: Adversarial attack emulation, exploit development, and continuous penetration testing.

soc_dfir.name: Security Operations & Digital Forensics (DFIR)
soc_dfir.description: SIEM ingestion, Sigma rule detection engineering, malware memory forensics, and incident response.

product_manager.domain_objectives: Define security boundaries, data classification levels (Confidential, Secret), and regulatory compliance posture.
product_manager.requirements_rubric: Threat model requirements, authentication workflows, least-privilege matrix, and incident response SLAs.
forbidden_pitfalls: Unencrypted sensitive data in transit/at rest

system_architect.domain_objectives: Architect defense-in-depth, zero trust zones, cryptographic key management, and air-gapped security boundaries.

adversarial_sdet.threat_model: Authentication bypass, injection attacks (SQLi, SSRF, Command Injection), IDOR, CSRF, race condition privilege escalation.
adversarial_sdet.boundary_fuzzing: Probe API endpoints with path traversal payloads, null bytes (%00), prototype pollution, and malformed JWT tokens.

core_engineer.coding_idioms: Defensive programming, parameterized queries, strict input sanitization, safe deserialization, constant-time algorithms.
core_engineer.concurrency_rules: Thread-safe cryptographic state, atomic token invalidation, rate-limited resource acquisition.
core_engineer.memory_and_resource_rules: Zeroization of sensitive memory buffers after use, memory-safe data structures, stack canary protection.

technical_writer.documentation_lexicon: Threat models, attack surface matrices, CVSS vulnerability reports, and statutory compliance dockets.
technical_writer.architectural_diagram_style: Trust boundary diagrams, data flow diagrams (DFD), and attack tree visualizations.
